title: A Manual Punch column is a zigzag across the column
description: A 5 × 2 mm Manual Punch column sewn in satin at density 3, without under sewing, must sew its body as PE-DESIGN 11.50 does: every stitch crosses the column, alternating between the two long edges (one crossing along each rung, the next slanted back), with no short stitch along an edge. The tie-in and end lock at the column's ends are measured apart.

featureMatrix.feature: Manual Punch: shapes made of several sewing-direction lines

evidence.note: docs/COMPATIBILITY_AUDIT.md item 1 (Defect: a square wave is wrong regardless of PE-DESIGN)
Region sewing attributes: satin is shown only in pictures

PE-DESIGN 11.50 round-1 reference (PR #34) was made with under sewing on, PE's default: 40 stitches, of which 13-15 are under sewing. Under sewing is off here so the spec tests the top satin's shape only (coordinator decision, 2026-10-27); the reference is to be remade with under sewing off.
PE-DESIGN 11.50, under sewing off (compat/reference/stitches/satin-zigzag-column.pes, 2026-10-27): 18 stitches = tie-in (2), 8 rungs 5/7 mm apart sewn as a sawtooth (15 crossings), end lock (2).

references.make: With Shapes > Manual Punch > Straight Block (sew type Satin Stitch), punch a 5 mm long, 2 mm wide straight column between (10, 10)–(10, 12) and (15, 10)–(15, 12) mm, density 3.0 lines/mm, Under Sewing off, other attributes default. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).
